thread:
Kai - Partner PM: FYI kicking off Terra Systems co-sell onramp. Need tech handoff: tenant, SSO, egress, telemetry, entitlements, pricing floor. @Jordan please confirm pricing guardrails. @Lucy please own POC test dataset + model selection. We'll aim for a 2-week pilot.

Jordan - Sales Eng: Thanks. For pricing they want committed reserved capacity + overage. Need monthly min and peak qps. Can we propose dev tier + burst? cc @Samir for capacity sizing.

Lucy - Solutions Eng: For the POC let's start with a chat endpoint on gpt-small-open variant. Need sample dataset (~500 convs) and a seed prompt. I'll prep the eval harness.

Nadia - Partner (Terra Systems): We have a compliance checklist and infra needs VPC peering + KMS. SSO via SAML and SCIM provisioning. Can you provide a runbook and expected IP ranges?

Samir - Platform Eng: Telemetry options: we can stream per-request traces to a webhook endpoint or export batches to S3. Which do you prefer? Also need expected token/sec so we can size routing group and routing policy.

Kai - Partner PM: Nadia prefers webhook. Samir can you share sample webhook payload and auth header (HMAC) by EOD? Also we need entitlements mapping for feature flags (dedicated cache, quant profiles).

Samir - Platform Eng: Sample payload below; will add signing example shortly:

```
POST /telemetry/events HTTP/1.1
Authorization: HMAC-SHA256 <sig>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "req_id": "{{request_id}}",
  "model": "gpt-small-open",
  "latency_ms": 42,
  "tokens": 128,
  "status": "ok"
}
```

I'll also produce a small load estimate doc (tokens/sec, concurrent sessions) and a signed-header snippet.

onboard-bot: tenant 'terra-sandbox' created (tenant_id: t-9a4f2). SSO SAML config pending. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/t-9a4f2

Nadia - Partner (Terra Systems): Great — can we get target SLA numbers on latency? Their policy calls for 99.9% uptime and ~100ms p50 on small prompts.

Jordan - Sales Eng: 99.9% is supported on Dedicated; hosted tier we can offer 99.5. Need confirmation whether they want Dedicated capacity. Pricing floor idea: $12k/month commit for 4 GPUs reserved, with burst on demand.

Lucy - Solutions Eng: For rapid iteration we can do initial POC on hosted, then move to Dedicated if SLA/pricing is confirmed. I'll prepare the harness and seed prompts.

Kai - Partner PM: Action items:
- Samir: webhook payload + HMAC example + load estimate (due EOD)
- Lucy: POC dataset + eval harness (due Wed)
- Jordan: draft pricing commit + architecture options (Dedicated vs Hosted) (due Thu)
- Nadia: send compliance questionnaire and SSO metadata
I'll set a check-in Thurs 11am PT. :calendar: 

Nadia - Partner (Terra Systems): Sending questionnaire now. SSO metadata shared via S3: https://s3.terra/sso-metadata.xml

Samir - Platform Eng: Uploaded webhook sample + sha256 signing snippet to shared folder: https://repo.redwood/partnerships/terra/telemetry. Egress IPs to whitelist: 3.22.11.0/24, 18.205.0.0/16, 54.192.0.0/12

Lucy - Solutions Eng: Quick Q — partner legal asks whether PII should be stripped from telemetry. Do we have an OOB toggle?

Samir - Platform Eng: Yes, we can hash or redact at ingestion. There's a telemetry config flag to remove PII fields before forwarding; will include examples in the runbook.

Kai - Partner PM: Thanks all — if nothing blocks, target pilot kickoff Monday next week. :thumbsup:
